title: Gaza Sports Club captain Mahmoud Abdel-Malek killed in Sabra airstrike
detail: A 20-year-old footballer, captain and goalkeeper of Gaza Sports Club, was killed in an Israeli air strike on Gaza City's Sabra neighbourhood, the Palestinian Football Association confirmed. The PFA counts him as the 1,017th person involved in sport killed in Gaza since Oct 2023. Al Jazeera also cites a cumulative toll of 74,645 killed.

title: Israeli strikes hit tent camp in Gaza, killing five
detail: Israeli strikes hit a camp of displaced people's tents in Gaza, killing five people, according to Al Jazeera (Nov 11, 2026).
